Permutation Test of a Rank or Linear Correlation

Source: R/analysis-resampling.R
PermutationCorrelation.Rd

Computes Spearman's rho (Pearson correlation of midranks) or Pearson's r for the complete pairs of each group, with a two-sided permutation p value: Monte Carlo with a declared R seed, (b + 1) / (B + 1) where b counts permuted absolute correlations at least the observed one, or exact enumeration of all n! orderings (mean of the same indicator).

Usage

PermutationCorrelation(
  data,
  x,
  y,
  groups = NULL,
  method = c("spearman", "pearson"),
  permutations = c("monte_carlo", "exact"),
  n_perm = 99999L,
  seed = NULL,
  min_n = 4L,
  max_exact_n = 9L,
  tolerance = 1e-12
)

Arguments

data

Data frame.

x, y

Numeric columns.

groups

Optional group columns.

method

"spearman" or "pearson".

permutations

"monte_carlo" or "exact".

n_perm

Number of Monte Carlo permutations.

seed

Optional whole-number seed for Monte Carlo draws; every group starts from it. The caller's random stream is restored.

min_n

Smallest number of complete pairs tested (at least 2).

max_exact_n

Largest n accepted for exact enumeration.

tolerance

Absolute tolerance in the comparison with the observed correlation.

Value

A data frame with the group columns, n, estimate, p_value, method, permutations, n_perm (number of orderings used), seed and status.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), y = c(2, 1, 4, 3, 6, 5))
PermutationCorrelation(d, "x", "y", permutations = "exact")
#>   n  estimate    p_value   method permutations n_perm seed status
#> 1 6 0.8285714 0.05833333 spearman        exact    720   NA TESTED
PermutationCorrelation(d, "x", "y", n_perm = 999, seed = 1)
#>   n  estimate p_value   method permutations n_perm seed status
#> 1 6 0.8285714   0.054 spearman  monte_carlo    999    1 TESTED
